content: We visualize the heat maps of attention results. As shown in Fig. FIGREF47 , deeper background color represents larger attention score. The attention score is calculated with Eq. ( EQREF15 ). We take the average of the resulting INLINEFORM0 attention matrix over the time dimension to obtain attention values for each word.
